critical_code_review_comments: AccessGateContext.jsx (web) & access.tsx (mobile) — clean, auth-agnostic gate() pattern; single source of truth via useAuth().isOwner. Good.
Backend AccessRequestReq model normalises email to lowercase before dedup (verified via debug curl) — good idempotency guarantee even if callers vary casing.

SystemHealthChip.jsx L48-56 — the pill acts both as trigger for the Popover (owner) and as a plain button that calls gate() (public). Correct branching but consider extracting the pill JSX into its own tiny component to avoid duplication risk in future.

MetricExplainer.jsx L57 gate('Detailed metric explanations') is called INSIDE onClick BEFORE setOpen — good; for public visitors gate() returns false and setOpen never fires, so the info card stays hidden and only the waitlist modal opens. Verified in code (no metric-explainer instance exists on public Cockpit today to visually confirm, but the code path is trivially correct).
AskAnanta.jsx L48-55 — public path renders only the chip button and short-circuits before the settings polling useEffect can fire — no wasted /api/settings polling for anonymous visitors. Good.
